items.docs: Updates any combination of a feature's metadata, default value, environment state, and rules. Other top-level fields are patch-merged: omit a field to leave it unchanged. The `rules` field, when supplied, replaces the entire `rules` array atomically in a single revision (v1 PUT applied per-environment patches; v2 swaps the full flat array). To preserve existing rules during a partial edit, GET the feature first, mutate the returned `rules` array, and PUT the full array back. Safe-rollout rules r
